about: Queue for the Open Hips mannequin clips, generated in the Gemini web app (Create video, Portrait, text only, one new chat per clip). Attaching an image to a video prompt failed 3 times on 2026-11-18, so prompts are text only. Pose descriptions are Claude's reading of the exercise names in content/programs/hips.ts; Felipe has not checked them yet.
muscle_effect: Felipe asked on 2026-11-18 for the look of the hip hydrant clip: anatomical muscle fibers glowing through the clothes, plus the joint. A flat glow counts as wrong.
run_rules: If 'Create video' is greyed out in the Upload & tools menu, the video quota is used up: stop the run and report it. It was greyed out on 2026-11-18 at about 10:55 after 2 finished videos and 4 failed attempts that morning.
Find the 'Create video' menu item and the aspect ratio options with the find tool, not fixed coordinates; the menu position changes.
A clip is ok only if the working muscle shows as glowing anatomical fibers visible through the shorts, like the hip hydrant clip. A flat or blocky glow is wrong.

After a clip is ok: click 'Download video' in its Gemini chat, move the newest ~/Downloads/gemini_generated_video_*.mp4 to assets/glossary/<slug>-raw.mp4, then make the page version: ffmpeg -i assets/glossary/<slug>-raw.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -crf 24 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart public/programs/hips/clips/<slug>.mp4, and add "<slug>": "/programs/hips/clips/<slug>.mp4" to HIPS_CLIPS in content/programs/hips-clips.ts. Do not commit or deploy; Felipe has not asked for that.
Gemini shows 'You're out of videos for now' with the time videos come back. Record that time in the report.

Felipe asked on 2026-11-18 for this to run without him acting. At the start of every run call CronList: if clips are still pending and no recurring job for this queue exists (recurring jobs expire after 7 days), create a new one with CronCreate, cron '17 */3 * * *', using the same instructions as this run.
When the queue has no pending clips left, delete the recurring job and tell Felipe which clips are ok, which stayed wrong after 2 attempts, and that nothing has been committed or deployed.

template: A smooth beige 3D anatomy mannequin, male, faceless with no eyes and no mouth, visible ball joints at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles, athletic build, wearing only black shorts, white crew socks and white sneakers. Dark gym, black rubber floor, neon green rim light from the right, nobody else in the room. {view}, static camera that never moves, entire body in frame, no tripod or camera equipment anywhere in the room. He starts already in this position: {start} He does only one movement: {motion} Exactly 3 slow repetitions, then he holds still in the starting position. He never changes position and never does any other movement. Working muscles: {glow}. They light up as glowing neon green anatomical muscle fibers drawn as a graphic overlay on top of the body and on top of the black shorts, so wherever a working muscle is under the shorts its glow shows on the shorts too, with visible fiber strands in the real shape of each muscle, brightest while the muscle works and dimmer when it rests. No red or skinless muscle anywhere: outside the green glow the body stays smooth plain beige. No cuts, no text. Portrait 9:16.

clips.name: Lunge Pulse
clips.start: a long lunge stance, right foot flat on the floor far in front, left leg behind, torso upright, hands on hips.
clips.motion: he slowly lowers his hips straight down until the back knee is just above the floor, pauses, then rises to the start.
clips.glow: the front of the left hip and the right thigh
clips.note: 10 s, one mannequin facing left, lunge with 2 lowerings then a hold, green muscle fibers on the thigh during the reps. On the program page. Not reviewed by Felipe.

clips.name: Single Leg RDL
clips.start: standing tall on the right leg, left foot just off the floor, hands on hips.
clips.motion: he hinges forward at the hip with a flat back while the left leg lifts straight behind him until torso and leg are parallel to the floor, pauses, then returns to standing.
clips.glow: the right hamstring and right glute
clips.note: 2026-11-20 15:46 ok with model set to Auto: 10 s, one mannequin, side view, 3 hinges with the left leg lifting behind, green fiber glow on hamstring/glute. Hinge is shallower than parallel and the free foot touches down between reps. 6 earlier tries errored because the model picker was on 'Hydrogen'.

clips.name: Pigeon Stretch
clips.start: pigeon pose on the floor, right shin folded across in front of the hips with the right knee out to the side, left leg extended straight back along the floor, torso upright, fingertips on the floor beside the hips.
clips.motion: he slowly folds his torso forward and down until his chest is low over the front shin and his forearms rest on the floor, pauses, then comes back upright.
clips.glow: only the right buttock and the outside of the right hip, on the side of the folded front leg (the extended back leg does not glow)
clips.note: Attempt 1 (2026-11-20, chat 7b15f257fb063d90 earlier): glow on the back leg's thigh, shallow fold. Attempt 2 (sent 2026-11-21 ~02:15, chat 3f99cdd55834b36b, checked 06:50): 10.0 s, one mannequin, pigeon pose, 3 forward folds onto the hands, good otherwise, but the glowing fibers are on the LEFT buttock/hip of the extended back leg again, not the folded front (right) leg. Max attempts reached; not downloaded. Felipe may still accept it (motion is right) or ask for a new wording, e.g. camera from the folded-leg side.

clips.name: Butterfly Stretch
clips.start: seated on the floor, soles of the feet together close to the body, knees open to the sides, hands holding the feet, spine tall.
clips.motion: he lets both knees sink toward the floor while leaning slightly forward with a long spine, pauses, then returns upright.
clips.glow: both inner thighs
clips.note: 2026-11-21 07:00 ok (attempt 1): 10.0 s, front view, one mannequin seated in butterfly, 3 slow forward leans with knees sinking, green fiber-strand glow on both inner thighs. Downloaded, page version made, added to HIPS_CLIPS.

clips.name: Standing Pancake Good Morning
clips.view: Side view, seen from his right
clips.start: standing with the feet very wide apart, about twice shoulder width, legs straight, hands on hips, torso upright.
clips.motion: he hinges forward at the hips with a flat back, pushing the hips back, until his torso is fully horizontal and parallel to the floor, pauses there, then stands back up.
clips.glow: the hamstrings on the back of both thighs, from the sitting bones under the shorts down to the backs of the knees, and the inner thighs (the front of the thighs does not glow)
clips.note: Attempt 1 (chat 87a0ee9b0daae460): shallow hinge, medium stance, glow on quads. Attempt 2 (2026-11-22 06:50, chat 91545ece75f9a4a5, side view): 10 s, one mannequin, 3 hinges, but stance is normal width (not a wide pancake stance), hinge only ~45 deg, glow covers whole thighs front and back and stops at the shorts' edge, and the thighs show red raw muscle at rest. Max attempts reached; not downloaded. Ask Felipe whether to retry with new wording.

clips.name: 90/90 Extension
clips.view: Three-quarter rear view from his left side, so his buttocks are clearly visible
clips.start: sitting with both sitting bones on the floor in a 90/90 position: right leg bent 90 degrees in front of him with the outside of the right shin flat on the floor across the body, left leg bent 90 degrees out to the left side and behind him with the inside of the left knee on the floor, torso upright, hands resting on the thighs.
clips.motion: he lifts his hips off the floor and rises up tall onto both knees, squeezing his buttocks, pauses, then sits back down onto the floor in the same 90/90 shape.
clips.glow: both buttocks (gluteus maximus), under the shorts, plus the front of the left hip
clips.note: 2026-11-22 07:15 wrong (attempt 1, chat 5bd90a2248d72f7e): 10 s, one mannequin, ~3 rises, but a camera tripod stood in the frame, he started half-kneeling instead of sitting in 90/90, the legs morphed/ghosted around 5 s, and the glow was on the front of the left thigh, not the glutes. But it is NOT 90/90: side view, both shins tucked under him, sitting on his heels and rising to tall kneeling (a kneeling glute lift). Final at max attempts; check with Felipe whether to accept it or reword (Gemini may not know the 90/90 seat).

clips.start: a long low kneeling lunge, right foot flat on the floor far in front with the knee bent, left knee and shin resting on the floor well behind the hips so the left thigh slopes backwards, torso upright, both arms reaching up with the hands well inside the frame.
clips.motion: he sinks his hips forward and down a little deeper, pauses, then eases back slightly.
clips.glow: only the back leg, the left leg whose knee is on the floor: the front of the left hip crease and the front of the left thigh from the hip down to the knee, under and on the shorts. The front right leg, the one with the foot flat on the floor, has no glow at all

Glow on the back leg's hip crease and front thigh (and a little on the shin), shown on the shorts; front leg has no glow. Fingertips and back toes touch the frame edges. clips.start: standing in a long split stance, right foot in front, left foot far behind on the ball of the foot, torso upright, hands on hips.
clips.motion: he sinks very deep, straight down, until the back knee is only a few centimetres above the floor and the front thigh is parallel to the floor with the front knee forward over the toes, pauses at the bottom, then rises back up.
clips.glow: the right thigh and the front of the left hip

clips.start: the frog stretch: chest low, both forearms flat on the floor, knees spread out to the sides as wide as possible with each knee bent 90 degrees, shins pointing straight back parallel to each other, insides of the feet flat on the floor, inner thighs close to the floor.
clips.motion: he slowly pushes his hips straight back toward his heels, keeping the knees wide and the forearms on the floor, pauses, then slowly rocks his hips forward again to the start.
clips.glow: only the inner thighs (adductors) of both legs, on the inside surface of each thigh facing the floor, from the inside of each knee all the way up under the shorts to the groin, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. He never stands up between sides.
clips.glow: only the inner thighs of both legs, on the inside surface of each thigh, from the inside of each knee all the way up under the shorts to the groin, and both glutes, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. clips.name: Couch Stretch

Looks like the Hip Flexor Lunge clip. Check with Felipe: accept as a lunge stretch, or film the couch stretch yourself.

clips.motion: he lifts the right leg with the knee kept bent at 90 degrees until the thigh is level with the back and the sole faces the ceiling, pauses, then lowers the knee back to the floor.

clips.note: 2026-11-27 ~09:30 ok (attempt 1): 10 s, one mannequin, side view on all fours, bent-knee leg lifts sole-up 3 times, glow on the glute showing on the shorts and down the back of the thigh, rests plain. (Generation hung ~2 h while the Mac slept, then finished.)

clips.name: Figure Four Stretch
clips.start: lying flat on his back on the floor, head, shoulders and whole back resting on the floor the whole time, left knee bent with the left foot flat on the floor, right ankle crossed over the left knee, both hands holding behind the left thigh.
clips.motion: still lying flat with his head and back on the floor, he pulls the left thigh toward his chest so the left foot lifts off the floor, pauses, then lets the left foot return to the floor. He never sits up.
clips.glow: only the right glute and right outer hip, on the back and side of the right hip under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts over the right buttock. No glow on the thighs or on the left side. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
clips.note: 2026-11-27 ~13:10 wrong (attempt 2, final): 10 s, one mannequin, side view, figure-four cross and glute glow on the shorts look good, but again he SITS upright instead of lying on his back. Check with Felipe: film it yourself, or try once in Flow (Omni 1.2 Flash).

clips.name: Flat Back Hamstring Stretch
clips.start: standing with the feet hip width apart and both legs straight, folded forward at the hips so his flat back is almost parallel to the floor, head in line with the back, both hands resting on the shins just below the knees.
clips.motion: staying folded forward the whole time with straight legs and a flat back, he pushes his hips a little further back so the chest moves a few centimeters closer to the thighs, pauses, then eases back slightly to the starting fold. It is a small movement; he never stands up straight and never rounds the back.
clips.glow: only the hamstrings on the back of both thighs, from behind each knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bones, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the front of the thighs, the back or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
clips.note: 2026-11-27 ~13:40 wrong (attempt 2, final), made in Flow (Omni 1.2 Flash, 8 s): flat-back hinge with 3 deeper folds, glow on the back of the thighs, but the glow stops at the shorts instead of continuing onto them, and he starts standing before folding. Candidate kept at assets/glossary/flat-back-hamstring-stretch-raw.mp4. Check with Felipe: accept as is?

clips.name: Pancake Stretch
clips.start: seated on the floor with both legs straight and spread wide apart, toes pointing up, torso upright, hands on the floor in front of him.
clips.motion: he walks his hands forward and folds from the hips with a flat back, pauses, then walks the hands back to sit upright.
clips.glow: both inner thighs and hamstrings
clips.note: 2026-11-27 ~16:10 ok (attempt 1), made in Flow (Omni 1.2 Flash, 8 s, 720x1280): front view, one mannequin seated in a wide straddle, 3 hand walk-outs into a forward fold, then sits upright. Glow on both inner thighs and over the shorts legs.

clips.name: Pigeon Good Morning
clips.start: classic yoga pigeon pose low on the floor: his right shin lies flat on the floor across the front of his body with the right knee bent out to the side and the right heel near his left hip; his left leg is stretched straight back behind him with the left knee and the top of the left foot flat on the floor; hips sink low toward the floor; torso upright, fingertips on the floor beside the hips.
clips.motion: he folds his torso forward over the front shin with a long flat back until his forearms rest on the floor in front of the shin, pauses, then pushes back up to upright.
clips.glow: the right glute and right outer hip
clips.note: 2026-11-27 ~16:20 wrong (attempt 1, Flow Omni 1.2 Flash): not pigeon; he kneels on both knees with hands behind the head and leans back and forth, and the fold leaves the frame. Reworded for the retry: side view, pigeon pose spelled out, hands on the floor. | 2026-11-27 ~16:30 wrong (attempt 2, final, Flow Omni 1.2 Flash): side view, but he kneels on both knees again instead of pigeon, the head leaves the frame on the fold, one rep turns into a backbend, and the glow sits on the front of the thigh, not the glute.

clips.name: 90/90 Iso
clips.start: sitting on his buttocks on the floor, not kneeling: feet planted wide apart, much wider than his hips, both knees bent 90 degrees and both knees lowered to the floor on his right side, so the right shin lies across the floor in front of him and the left shin points back on his left side, torso upright and leaning slightly forward, hands on the floor beside the hips.
clips.motion: he presses the right knee and right ankle down into the floor and squeezes his right buttock, holds the tension, then relaxes; his legs and hips never move.
clips.glow: the right buttock and the side of the right hip (gluteus maximus and gluteus medius), glowing on the right side of the black shorts
clips.note: 2026-11-27 ~19:10 wrong (attempt 1, Gemini, chat c504f79f80f051bc): 10 s, one mannequin, but he is in a half-kneeling lunge, not seated in 90/90, and the glow is on the front of the back thigh, not the glute. clips.name: Frog Stretch
clips.start: frog stretch on the floor: knees spread far out to the sides, much wider than his shoulders, inner thighs low and nearly parallel to the floor, knees bent 90 degrees with the shins pointing straight back and the feet turned out, both forearms flat on the floor in front of him, hips pushed back level with the knees.
clips.motion: he sinks his hips a little lower and further back, pauses, then eases off slightly.

clips.name: Lunge Quad Stretch
clips.start: a low kneeling lunge, right foot flat in front, left knee on the floor behind the hips, torso upright, left hand reaching back to hold the left foot.
clips.motion: he draws the left heel toward the left glute while pushing the hips forward, pauses, then lets the foot move away again without letting go.
clips.glow: the left thigh and the front of the left hip

clips.name: Standing Pancake
clips.start: standing with the feet very wide apart, legs straight, folded forward at the hips with both hands on the floor.
clips.motion: he walks his hands back between his feet and lowers his chest further toward the floor, pauses, then walks the hands forward to the start.
clips.glow: both hamstrings and inner thighs

clips.name: Wall Deep Squat
clips.start: a deep squat with the heels flat on the floor and the back resting lightly against a wall, elbows inside the knees, palms pressed together.
clips.motion: he presses his knees outward with his elbows and lifts his chest, pauses, then relaxes.
clips.glow: both inner thighs and glutes

clips.name: Elevated Pigeon
clips.start: standing behind a low wooden box with the right shin laid flat across the top of the box in a pigeon position, left leg straight back with the toes on the floor, hands on the box, torso upright.
clips.motion: he folds his torso forward over the right shin, pauses, then comes back upright.
clips.glow: the right outer hip and right glute

clips.name: Middle Split Negatives
clips.start: standing with the feet wide apart, legs straight, toes pointing forward, torso leaning forward with both hands on the floor in front of him.

clips.glow: both inner thighs

clips.name: Seated Pancake Reach
clips.start: seated on the floor with both legs straight and spread wide apart, toes pointing up, torso upright, both arms reaching straight forward at shoulder height.
clips.motion: he reaches both arms forward and down toward the floor, folding from the hips with a long spine, pauses, then sits back upright.
clips.glow: both inner thighs and hamstrings
